tasks.title: Define Sula 0.17.0 agent-native project OS upgrade execution package
tasks.description: Create the whitepaper, overview, workflow records, and phased task package for implementing the Sula 0.17.0 agent-native project operating system upgrade.
acceptance_criteria: The 0.17.0 whitepaper defines product boundary, MCP-compatible surface, safety model, phased implementation order, and definition of done.
The execution package breaks the upgrade into independently verifiable task packages.
README and overview docs link to the 0.17.0 whitepaper.
A change record, workflow spec, workflow plan, and workflow review record exist for the planning package.
